text:
Maria: Working on the benchmark narrative for launch next week — want a lean set of charts + quick email/webinar routing. Thoughts?
Ethan: Love lean. Propose 3 panels: 1) tokens/ms (throughput vs prompt length) 2) cost per 1k tokens across models/quantizations (bar) 3) tail latency p95/p99 line across load. Keep y-axis dollars where relevant.
Priya: Agree. For messaging we should lead with 'predictable unit economics' rather than raw latency numbers. Audiences: PLG devs vs enterprise. Two CTAs: 'try hosted API' and 'book demo for dedicated'.
Lina: I can mock the 3 panels today. Quick Q: color palette—use green for Redwood baseline, gray for open baseline, orange for quantized?
Ken: For demos, we need a routing rule: leads with >10k tokens/day go to sales; webinar signups to SDR flow. Can we add hidden form field to capture estimated monthly tokens?
Maria: Yes on hidden field. Priya, wanna draft two short headlines I can A/B test in the email subject? One technical, one business.
Priya: Technical: 'How to cut inference spend without raising latency.' Business: 'Same speed, half the bill — inference that scales.'
Ethan: Numbers: use sample from internal bench: hosted baseline 3.2 tokens/ms, quantized 2.7 tokens/ms; cost per 1k tokens hosted $0.28, quantized $0.12; p95 180ms, p99 420ms. Use ranges not exact SLAs.
Maria: Perfect. Lina, can you avoid showing absolute IP from the infra? Use relative deltas in the visual footnote.
Lina: Will do. Mockup ETA 6pm PST. I'll attach version to this thread.
ops-bot: deploy-bench-bot: Latest run 2026-03-22 20:10 UTC attached — summary: mean tokens/ms 3.1, cost/1k_est $0.13, p99 400ms.
Ken: :thumbsup: with those numbers sales can craft an enterprise case. Maria, can we get a single-sentence elevator copy for demo pages?
Maria: Draft: 'Ship LLM features with predictable latency and a clear cost story — plug in your workload and see unit economics.' Feedback?
Ethan: Shorten to 'Ship LLM features with predictable latency and transparent unit economics.'
Maria: Great. Final asks: Lina attach visuals, Priya finalize A/B subject lines, Ken add routing rule to the demo form, I'll schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow 9am PT to approve assets.
Priya: On it.
Ken: I'll add the routing config to the CRM by EOD.
Lina: Uploading mock v1 now.
Maria: Thanks everyone — if anything blocks, flag it here. :rocket:
